description: This file defines the IGrainServiceFactory interface and its implementation GrainServiceFactory, which provides functionality for casting grain references to grain service references within Orleans runtime.

classes.name: GrainServiceFactory
classes.description: Implementation of IGrainServiceFactory that uses IRuntimeClient to obtain grain service references.

methods.name: CastToGrainServiceReference
methods.description: Casts a grain reference to a typed grain service reference using the runtime client's grain factory.
